description: Draw and edit mathematical diagrams in Questi Geo, then save PNG and editable GGB files locally and provide their paths using host browser/computer-use tools.

defaultPrompt: Recreate this diagram in Questi Geo. Export matching PNG and GGB, verify both, and provide downloads. Report any export failure.
Draw one triangle with a dashed altitude. Export PNG and GGB, reopen to compare, and attach both plus an unchanged ZIP.
Plot y=x^2-1 for -2<=x<=2 in Questi Geo. Export matching PNG and GGB downloads. Report any missing or unverified output.
interface.longDescription: Use Questi Geo's existing browser editor to construct geometry, edit functions, trace a reference, and import GGB files. Drawing tasks finish with a PNG capture and editable GGB saved locally, verified, and linked by their actual paths. Process videos are optional extras, not substitutes for the files. Requires browser/computer-use and download/file access supplied by the host. Image-to-GGB conversion requires Questi sign-in and credit confirmation; ordinary drawing and local downloads do not.

name: questi-geo
